chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me of it, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, raising it, who said:
If he became junub, then he must perform ghusl according to what occurred from him; and if he had a wet dream, he performs tayammum.

key_terms.أَجْنَبَ: entered the state of janabah (major ritual impurity)

ai.seo_question: When must a junub perform ghusl, and when is tayammum sufficient?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity for one in a state of janabah. It distinguishes between janabah resulting from an act requiring ghusl and a case of iḥtilām in which tayammum is mentioned.
